title: The Real Cost of a Lamborghini Revuelto (Options, Taxes, Insurance)
description:
In October twenty twenty-six, a Lamborghini Revuelto test car left the press fleet with a window sticker of eight hundred six thousand five hundred twenty-one dollars. The base price was about six hundred sixty-five thousand. The rest was options, delivery, and a tax most people do not expect on a plug-in hybrid. So what does a Revuelto really cost, from the order form to the day you sell it? Today we go line by line. The base price and how it climbed, the options that cost more than a normal car, the taxes, the insurance, the fuel, the service, and the used market, where something unusual is happening. Then we add it all up, using only published numbers.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
